other_accessions_in_paper.GSE158984: scRNA-seq of muscle ECs, including sedentary vs 14-day voluntary wheel running (S2.5.p1, KRT/TAB1 line 177); not the accession assigned here

assay: bulk RNA-seq (Smart-seq2 / TruSeq per GEO), kallisto quantification, FACS-sorted muscle endothelial cells (S4.4.3.p1)
samples: 20 samples: RmECs (soleus, oxidative) and WmECs (EDL, glycolytic) from WT and Atf4 EC-knockout (Atf4^dEC/dEC) mice, n=5 per group (GEO titles; S2.6.p1, Fig6B-D)
exercise_factor_in_this_accession: none: all bulk samples are sedentary/unperturbed mice; exercise (14-day wheel running) appears only in histology, EdU/flow, and the scRNA-seq of GSE158984 (S2.5.p1, Fig5, Fig6E-I)
primary_estimand: Baseline transcriptional difference between oxidative (RmEC) and glycolytic (WmEC) capillary ECs, and its dependence on Atf4 (S2.2.p2, S2.6.p1). Not an exercise effect.
planned_contrasts: WT RmEC vs WT WmEC (S2.2.p2, Fig2G, S2.6.p1; paper: 782 DEGs)
Atf4-KO RmEC vs Atf4-KO WmEC (S2.6.p1, Fig6B; paper: 211 remaining of WT DEGs)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.6.p1; Fig6C legend; S4.4.3.p2 ('log fold change > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05')

paper_method: DESeq2 on kallisto counts, genes with <=1 count across all samples removed (S4.4.3.p1)
